name: The Corruption Abroad
summary: In Stormwind, Argos Nightwhisper seeks adventurers to aid his brother in northern Kalimdor. Gershala studies a spreading decay in Darkshore, where he needs fresh hands.

sections.title: An Envoy in the Human Capital
sections.body: Stormwind faces internal turmoil and unrest in its surrounding regions. Even so, envoys from distant kaldorei lands walk its stone streets. Argos Nightwhisper seeks seasoned champions willing to look beyond human borders. The kaldorei are relatively new allies to the Eastern Kingdoms, and formal military aid is scarce. So families and researchers recruit independent champions who will answer the call.

sections.title: The Call of Darkshore
sections.body: Argos points you toward auberdine, a misty port on Darkshore’s fog-shrouded coast. His brother Gershala studies an ominous malaise afflicting the local wildlife and flora. Reaching him means a long voyage from stormwind harbor across the Great Sea. It is a traveler’s first true passage into Kalimdor’s ancient wilderness.

faq.answer: Argos Nightwhisper is a night elf visitor staying in Stormwind. As an emissary for his family, he recruits experienced Alliance adventurers to cross the sea and aid his brother Gershala in Darkshore.
Gershala Nightwhisper is in auberdine, a coastal night elf settlement on the western shore of Darkshore in northern Kalimdor.

Gershala investigates an unnatural corruption spreading through Darkshore’s wilderness. It afflicts local wildlife, water sources, and vegetation, and he needs seasoned champions to gather samples and investigate its cause.

faq.q: How do I get to Auberdine from Stormwind?
faq.answer: Board the ship at the southern-most dock of stormwind harbor. It sails across the Great Sea to auberdine in Darkshore.

faq.q: Can I do this quest if I already went to Darkshore?
aliases: can i still do corruption abroad
faq.answer: If you have already visited auberdine and begun Gershala’s ‘Researching the Corruption’ directly from him, you can no longer take or complete Argos’s introductory summons.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Argos and Gershala?
faq.answer: Argos and Gershala Nightwhisper are brothers. Gershala remains on the front lines studying the blight in Darkshore, while Argos crosses the sea to seek capable allies in Stormwind.

angles.text: This summons shows the fledgling bonds between the night elves of Kalimdor and Stormwind’s human kingdom across the sea.
For you, Argos is a reminder of the troubles facing the ancestral forests of northern Kalimdor while you are far from home.
Your journey to Darkshore offers a first glimpse of ancient kaldorei culture, far from Elwynn’s stone castles.
